candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall first head current prev before next, current <> 0 -> current <> next -> xizi_dllseg first head current prev before ** xizi_dll_links current next prev |-- xizi_dllseg first head next current (before ++ [current])
premises: current <> 0 comes from the nonempty-loop invariant
current <> next is direct when next is the sentinel at return, and in the transition follows after unfolding the suffix and using separation of current/next link cells

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Keep the five witnesses together as one invariant lifecycle. Initialize by opening xizi_dll or selecting the direct-segment alternative. For the general transition, unfold the nonempty suffix, extend the processed prefix with the suffixed snoc helper, instantiate done = done_2 ++ [next_2] and todo = l0, and show the 32-bit increment does not wrap from the total-length bound. For the initial transition use before = nil and unfold the first suffix node. For nonempty return force the suffix at the sentinel to nil, append tmp_node to the prefix, and close xizi_dll (or prove the segment alternative). For empty return force todo = nil from a segment whose node equals its stop and rebuild the empty list shape.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_len_entail_wit: Select the direct-segment alternative with todo = nodes, or open xizi_dll and choose done = nil; pure app/Zlength facts simplify and all spatial resources are preserved.

Use the full-resource alternative, unfold the guarded suffix to obtain todo_2 = next_2 :: l0 and next_2's links, append tmp_node to the prefix, and instantiate before = done_2, done = done_2 ++ [next_2], todo = l0.
Use the initial-iteration alternative, unfold the guarded segment at first_2, take before = nil, done = [first_2], todo = l0, and retain sentinel/first-node links and the residual suffix.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_len_return_wit: From next = linklist_pre, destruct todo; the nonempty case contradicts the stop guard, while nil yields the endpoint equality. Append tmp_node to the prefix, rewrite nodes = done, and close xizi_dll.
From first = linklist_pre, destruct todo; only nil is possible. Rewrite nodes = nil and linklist_length = 0, derive last = linklist_pre from the empty segment, and choose the empty-list post shape.

vc_shape.family: sentinel circular doubly linked list prefix/suffix invariant
vc_shape.spatial_core: xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg with paired node_next/node_prev cells and sentinel closure
vc_shape.pure_core: nodes = done ++ todo, counter = Zlength done, total Zlength decomposition, and UINT32 no-wrap bound

witness_instantiation.initial: done = nil and todo = nodes; after the first iteration before = nil, done = [first_2], todo = l0
witness_instantiation.transition: before = done_2, done = done_2 ++ [next_2], todo = l0
witness_instantiation.nonempty_return: todo = nil and the closing node is tmp_node
witness_instantiation.empty_return: done = todo = nodes = nil and first = last = linklist_pre

proof_groups.space_plan: Use existing xizi_dll open/close and xizi_dllseg unfolding facts, plus one group-suffixed snoc helper; frame the sentinel closure and residual suffix.
proof_groups.pure_plan: Normalize app and Zlength. The active loop transition implies the new prefix length is old length + 1 and at most total length; Zlength nodes <= 2^32-1 and nonnegativity make unsigned_last_nbits exact.

premise_discharge.segment_snoc: tmp_node <> 0 is an invariant fact; at return tmp_node <> linklist_pre is explicit, and in transition tmp_node <> next_2 follows from the separated link resources after suffix unfolding
premise_discharge.unsigned_increment: linklist_length = Zlength done_2, nodes = done_2 ++ next_2 :: l0, Zlength l0 >= 0, and xizi_double_link_size nodes = Zlength nodes <= 4294967295

proof_groups.grouping_reason: All five witnesses are phases of one loop invariant over the same xizi_dllseg predicate, share one helper family and the same list-length arithmetic, and 5 is below the controller maximum 12; splitting would duplicate the helper/proof context without a dependency or strategy boundary.
